newsitem.title: UK: Turkey 500 mln mark Eurobond to be for seven years.
newsitem.headline: Turkey 500 mln mark Eurobond to be for seven years.

text.p: Turkey's expected 500 million mark Eurobond was likely to have a seven-year maturity and be launched this week, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
Commerzbank was tipped as one of two lead managers on the deal. Officials there declined to comment.
Spread talk for a seven-year deal was around 275 basis points over government paper, traders said.

Turkey last tapped the mark sector in November 1996 with a 750 million mark five-year bond. Priced to yield 280 b.p. over Bunds, the deal tightened by around 20 b.p. Commerzbank and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were joint lead managers on the issue.
Also in the pipeline is a 500 billion Italian lire five-year bond for Turkey, due in late February or early March, via Chase.
Turkey said it was planning to raise $2.0 billion in the international capital markets this year after a total of $2.9 billion in 1996.
